question.text: Ms. Priya Shah, a Company Secretary with 5 years of NPO audit experience, applies for SIA empanelment. Under SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations 2008, the 'fit and proper person' criterion (Schedule II) requires assessment of:

answer.text: Only the applicant's professional qualification, nothing more
Integrity, reputation, absence of convictions, financial soundness, and absence of regulatory bars
Only the employer NPO's track record — not the applicant individual

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Schedule II of SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations 2008 requires the Board to be satisfied of integrity, honesty, reputation, character, absence of convictions (including economic offence), financial integrity and absence of regulatory sanction / bar. Professional qualification is only ONE component. **The Trap:** Qualification alone is insufficient (Option A). Net-worth/CIBIL alone (C) is too narrow — reputation and integrity dominate. Employer-track-record (D) is irrelevant — the test is personal to the applicant. **Cross-Exam Context:** V-A (MF Distributor) and XV (Research Analyst) also apply fit-and-proper under SEBI Intermediaries 2008 Schedule II — the criteria are harmonised across intermediary classes. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** Before filing your empanelment form, run a self-check: any CIBIL default, any SEBI/ROC adverse order, any criminal case — disclose all in the self-declaration. An undisclosed item, even minor, becomes grounds for later cancellation under Reg 27 of the same 2008 regulations.
